soundfonts.name: AVL Drumkits — Black Pearl
soundfonts.description: Black Pearl acoustic kit recorded with 5 velocity layers per piece, packaged as a single SF2 for the AVL LV2 plugin. CC-BY-SA-3.0.

soundfonts.name: AVL Drumkits — Blonde Bop
soundfonts.description: Blonde Bop kit: a tight, dry jazz-leaning kit with 5-10 velocity layers per piece. CC-BY-SA-3.0.

soundfonts.name: AVL Drumkits — Red Zeppelin
soundfonts.description: Red Zeppelin kit: a bigger, roomier rock kit with 5 velocity layers per piece. CC-BY-SA-3.0.

soundfonts.name: Bagpipe (small)
soundfonts.description: A bagpipe in G recorded in 2020 by Gilles Sadowski; the small SF2 variant trims the sample set while keeping the drone and chanter.

soundfonts.name: Church Organ Emulation
soundfonts.description: Church pipe organ: a big, sustained sound that wants reverb on the track.

soundfonts.name: Clarinet
soundfonts.description: Clarinet with sustains and short articulations.

soundfonts.name: Concert Harp
soundfonts.description: Concert harp with plucked sustains, small variant. Samples come from the CC0 Versilian Community Sample Library; only the page's promo photo is CC BY-NC.

soundfonts.name: Drawbar Organ
soundfonts.description: Hammond-style drawbar organ recorded from the setBfree software synthesizer.

soundfonts.name: Electric Guitar Clean (bridge, small)
soundfonts.description: FSBS electric guitar, clean bridge pickups, small variant. Hosted as a GitHub release asset from the FreePats project itself.

soundfonts.name: Electric Guitar Direct (DI)
soundfonts.description: The raw direct-input signal of a Fender electric guitar, meant to be fed through an amp simulator rather than played dry.

soundfonts.name: Electric Guitar Distorted #1
soundfonts.description: FSBS distorted electric guitar #1: the same Fender guitar through a high-gain amp and effects chain.

soundfonts.name: Electric Guitar Distorted #2
soundfonts.description: FSBS distorted electric guitar #2, a heavier voicing of the same recorded instrument.

soundfonts.name: Electric Guitar Jazz (bridge, small)
soundfonts.description: FSBS jazz electric guitar: a Fender recorded direct, then run through an amp and effects chain; bridge pickup, small variant.

soundfonts.name: Fingered Electric Bass (YR)
soundfonts.description: Fingered electric bass from the same Yamaha RBX session as the picked variant; CC0.

soundfonts.name: FluidR3 GM
soundfonts.description: The classic free General MIDI SoundFont by Frank Wen, distributed as a zip containing FluidR3_GM.sf2. Larger and more detailed than MuseScore General, and the sample base both that bank and FluidR3Mono derive from.

soundfonts.name: FluidR3Mono GM
soundfonts.description: The mono, memory-lean version of FluidR3 GM (2.315) that MuseScore 2 shipped, MIT licensed. The Debian source tarball holds FluidR3Mono_GM2-315.SF2.

soundfonts.name: FM Piano #1 (DX7 E.Piano)
soundfonts.description: The Yamaha DX7 'E. Piano 1' patch, recorded from the Hexter software synthesizer: the glassy FM electric piano of countless 1980s records.

soundfonts.name: FM Piano #2 (bright)
soundfonts.description: A brighter variation of the DX7 electric piano, also recorded from Hexter.

soundfonts.name: FreePats General MIDI
soundfonts.description: FreePats' own General MIDI set: 45 melodic instruments plus a 43-entry percussion kit, deliberately incomplete and expanded release by release. GPL-3.0 with a linking exception.

soundfonts.name: FreePats GM Percussion Set
soundfonts.description: Standalone General MIDI percussion set with more layers than the kit inside the FreePats GM bank; cuica and timbales are still missing. GPL-3.0.

soundfonts.name: GeneralUser GS
soundfonts.description: The best-known lightweight GM/GS bank: 259 instrument presets and 11 drum kits under 30 MB of RAM, tuned for General MIDI playback and retro gaming. Distributed from the author's own site under a custom freeware licence, so this entry links to the download page instead of a direct file.

files.note: Custom GeneralUser GS licence: free to use, redistribution needs the author's terms. Add a direct file entry only once a stable, hashable mirror exists.

soundfonts.name: Glass
soundfonts.description: Glass harmonica / glass percussion: bell-like, fragile tones.

soundfonts.name: Hang (D Minor)
soundfonts.description: A hang tuned in D minor, recorded in 2017 in the Medialab-Prado auditorium; the bank covers the instrument's diatonic scale with its characteristic metallic ring.

soundfonts.name: Honky-Tonk Piano (small)
soundfonts.description: A Francis Bacon player piano recorded in stereo by Piotr Barcz: the detuned, historic honky-tonk tone. Small SF2 variant.

soundfonts.name: Jaw Harp
soundfonts.description: Jaw harp (khomus) with the twangy, formant-heavy character of the real instrument.

soundfonts.name: Kalimba
soundfonts.description: Thumb piano (kalimba) with soft, bell-like tines.

soundfonts.name: Lately Bass
soundfonts.description: The TX81Z 'Lately Bass' patch, recreated with Dexed and adapted for SF2.

soundfonts.name: Muldjord Drum Kit
soundfonts.description: Lars Muldjord's acoustic kit: two kicks, three hanging toms, floor tom, snare, hi-hat, two crashes, two rides and a china, with velocity layers. CC-BY-4.0.

soundfonts.name: MuseScore General
soundfonts.description: The General MIDI bank shipped with MuseScore: 128 melodic presets plus a drum kit, built on FluidR3Mono samples. The SF3 file is roughly 38 MB, the uncompressed SF2 roughly 206 MB.

soundfonts.name: MuseScore General HQ
soundfonts.description: The high-quality build of MuseScore General (S. Christian Collins' adaptation of FluidR3Mono), full 128-preset GM set. The Debian source tarball contains MuseScore_General_HQ.sf2.

soundfonts.name: New Age Pad
soundfonts.description: General MIDI program 89 (Synth Pad 1, new age) from ZynAddSubFX/Yoshimi.

soundfonts.name: Ocarina
soundfonts.description: Ocarina from Xavimart's instrument collection, recorded for FreePats.

soundfonts.name: OPL-3 FM 128M
soundfonts.description: A General MIDI bank built from OPL3 FM synthesis: the sound of early-1990s AdLib and Sound Blaster cards, with 128 melodic presets and a drum kit. CC-BY-SA-4.0.

soundfonts.name: Percussive Organ
soundfonts.description: Percussive Hammond organ variation by the Strix SoundFont Team.

soundfonts.name: Picked Electric Bass (YR)
soundfonts.description: Picked electric bass recorded from a Yamaha RBX by Andrea Biasior and released to FreePats under CC0.

soundfonts.name: Recorder
soundfonts.description: Recorder (blockflute) with clear, breathy tone. The archive is 7z, so the client links it rather than installing it.

soundfonts.name: Rock Organ Emulation
soundfonts.description: Transistor/rock organ with drawbar-style tone.

soundfonts.name: Saint James Orchestra Soundfonts
soundfonts.description: 48 separate orchestral SF2 banks — violin, viola, cello and bass with arco, legato, detache, pizzicato and tremolo variants, plus brass, woodwinds, harp, piano and percussion. GPL-3.0; the repository is the distribution point, so this entry opens it rather than a single archive.

files.note: One repository with 49 .sf2 files; download the ones you need (or the repo zip) and load them as separate banks.

soundfonts.name: Salamander Grand Piano
soundfonts.description: Alexander Holm's Salamander grand piano converted to SF2 by FreePats. CC-BY-3.0, so credit the original recording (and FreePats for the conversion) when you use it.

soundfonts.name: SGM V2.01
soundfonts.description: A large GM/GS bank split into three SF2 parts to fit GitHub's file-size limit: presets 0-30, 31-79, and 80-127 plus every GS drum kit. Download all three parts to get the complete bank. GPL-3.0.

files.note: Three .tar.gz parts (about 270 MB total); a client cannot merge them into one bank, so this entry links the project page.

soundfonts.name: Sonatina Symphonic Orchestra (SF2)
soundfonts.description: A complete free orchestral library converted from the original SFZ release into SoundFont banks: strings, woodwinds, brass, percussion, piano, harpsichord and chorus. 398 MB zip, so expect a long download.

files.note: The original sample library is under the obsolete CC Sampling Plus 1.0 licence, which forbids commercial redistribution.

soundfonts.name: Spanish Classical Guitar
soundfonts.description: Nylon-string classical guitar with round-robin and multiple velocity layers, packaged as a 7z archive containing an SF2.

soundfonts.name: Steel-String Guitar (small)
soundfonts.description: Steel-string acoustic guitar assembled from FlameStudios' Seagull samples; small variant. GPL-3.0, like the rest of the bank's samples.

soundfonts.name: Sweep Pad
soundfonts.description: General MIDI program 96 (Synth Pad 8, sweep) from ZynAddSubFX/Yoshimi.

soundfonts.name: Synth Bass & Lead
soundfonts.description: General MIDI program 88 (Synth Lead 8, bass + lead) made with Surge.

soundfonts.name: Synth Bass 1
soundfonts.description: General MIDI program 39 (Synth Bass 1), recorded from ZynAddSubFX/Yoshimi.

soundfonts.name: Synth Bass 2
soundfonts.description: General MIDI program 40 (Synth Bass 2): the DX7 'Bass 1' patch via Hexter.

soundfonts.name: Synth Brass 1
soundfonts.description: General MIDI program 63 (Synth Brass 1), recorded from ZynAddSubFX/Yoshimi.

soundfonts.name: Synth Brass 2
soundfonts.description: DX7 'Brass 7' patch rendered through Dexed for General MIDI program 63.

soundfonts.name: Synth Crystal
soundfonts.description: General MIDI program 99 (Synth FX 3, crystal) rendered from Dexed.

soundfonts.name: Synth Fifths
soundfonts.description: General MIDI program 87 (Synth Lead 7, fifths) made with Surge.

soundfonts.name: Synth Goblins
soundfonts.description: General MIDI program 102 (Synth FX 6, goblins) made with ZynAddSubFX.

soundfonts.name: Synth Lead Calliope
soundfonts.description: General MIDI program 83 (Synth Lead 3, calliope) from Hexter and ZynAddSubFX.

soundfonts.name: Synth Lead Square
soundfonts.description: General MIDI program 81 (Synth Lead 1, square) from ZynAddSubFX/Yoshimi.

soundfonts.name: Synth Pad Bowed
soundfonts.description: General MIDI program 93 (Synth Pad 5, bowed), samples by the Strix SoundFont Team.

soundfonts.name: Synth Pad Choir
soundfonts.description: General MIDI program 92 (Synth Pad 4, choir) made with ZynAddSubFX.

soundfonts.name: Synth Sci-Fi
soundfonts.description: General MIDI program 104 (Synth FX 8, sci-fi) made with Surge.

soundfonts.name: Synth Soundtrack
soundfonts.description: General MIDI program 98 (Synth FX 2, soundtrack) made with ZynAddSubFX.

soundfonts.name: Synth Strings 1
soundfonts.description: General MIDI program 51 (Synth Strings 1) from ZynAddSubFX/Yoshimi.

soundfonts.name: Synth Strings 2
soundfonts.description: General MIDI program 52 (Synth Strings 2) from ZynAddSubFX/Yoshimi.

soundfonts.name: Synthesizer Percussion
soundfonts.description: Synthesised percussion hits (claps, blips, toms) for electronic parts.

soundfonts.name: Tenor Saxophone
soundfonts.description: Tenor saxophone with sustains and staccatos, small variant. Packaged as a tar.bz2 archive containing an SF2.

soundfonts.name: TimGM6mb
soundfonts.description: The 6 MB General MIDI bank that shipped with MuseScore 1: small enough to load on any laptop, still a serviceable GM fallback. GPL-2.0.

soundfonts.name: Timpani
soundfonts.description: Timpani assembled from Versilian Community Sample Library recordings, tuned for orchestral use.

soundfonts.name: Tubular Bells
soundfonts.description: Tubular bells assembled from Versilian Community Sample Library samples; the small SF2 variant keeps the strike and the long decay without the full multisample weight.

soundfonts.name: Ukulele
soundfonts.description: A tenor Flight Fireball ukulele sampled across C4-C6 in one session, with two percussive articulations.

soundfonts.name: Upright Piano KW (small)
soundfonts.description: FreePats' upright piano, small variant: one velocity layer per key, light enough to load on a laptop. 7z archive containing an SF2.

soundfonts.name: World Percussion
soundfonts.description: Hand percussion from Xavimart's collection: cajón, bongos, egg shaker, tambourine, claps, claves, castanets, conga, maracas and darbuka.

soundfonts.name: Xylophone (medium mallets)
soundfonts.description: Medium-mallet xylophone; the archive holds one SF2.

soundfonts.name: YDP Grand Piano
soundfonts.description: Built from the Zenph Studios Yamaha Disklavier Pro multisamples for OLPC, adapted to SF2 by FreePats; CC-BY-3.0.
